transcript: Emissing future society could be a balanced digital human society where technology improves life without replacing human connection. People will value mental well-being, equality, creativity and environmental care. Daily life will combine advanced technology with strong community relationships, allowing people to work smarter while still maintaining culture, emotion and social interactions.
